news_articles.title: Binance Announces Objective Moon: 100M EUR Crypto & Blockchain Initiative in France
news_articles.snippet: Binance today announced a partnership with France FinTech, on a 100M EUR initiative to help make France and Europe a leading global player in the blockchain and crypto industry.

news_articles.title: Karmen wins the France Fintech award
news_articles.snippet: Karmen joined France Fintech in June 2021 and participated in the Fintech R:evolution event on 14 October 2021.

news_articles.title: A. Clot (France FinTech): “Fundraising reached 2,3 billion euros in 2021” | France FinTech
news_articles.snippet: Its recruitments have been numerous, the sector now has 30 jobs and Francefintech expect to hire another 000 people in 10.

news_articles.title: Binance To Drop $115 Million On Building New Crypto Ecosystem in France
news_articles.snippet: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, is partnering with French non-profit France Fintech to make the country the center of Europe’s blockchain industry.

news_articles.title: Binance funds a $116 million initiative aimed at developing a crypto ecosystem in France
news_articles.snippet: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has partnered up with France Fintech, a non-profit organization to accelerate the adoption of cryptocurrency in France.
